lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: فَٰرِهِينَ is in the derivative form: فارِه
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ف/ر/ﻫ f–r–h to be good‐looking, to be accomplished, to be active. Of this root, فارِهين fārihın, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
فارِه fārih [quasi-act. part.] skillful; fine, comely

(26:149) وَتَنْحِتُونَ‏ ‏مِنَ‏ ‏الْجِبَالِ‏ ‏بُيُوتًا فَارِهِينَ and you carve out of the mountain [side] fine dwellings.
